response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer (14+ years) with strong breadth in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and testing practices, but the resume shows essentially no overlap with the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role: no SoC or IP modeling, no hardware/RTL or accelerator architecture work, no GPU/SIMD/MIMD experience, and no deep-learning training or inference optimization. The closest adjacent experience is low-latency microservice work at Sociomantic and some C/C++ work at National Instruments, which is application-level rather than hardware-software co-design. Education is a BSc in Computer Science, meeting the 8+ years threshold in years but not in relevant technical domain. This is a fundamental domain mismatch rather than a seniority gap.
strengths: 14+ years of software engineering experience, currently at staff level
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput systems work (async I/O, fibers, caching) in DLang
Some C/C++ systems and embedded exposure plus strong engineering rigor (TDD, CI/CD, tooling)
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No deep-learning workload, GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or AI accelerator background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product engineering, not performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator / deep-learning workload optimization background
Extensive senior software engineering and low-latency systems experience
